description.zh: 数据源ID。您可调用接口[ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~)，查询数据源列表，获取**DataSourceId**。
description.en: The data source ID. You can call the [ListParserDataSource](~~432676~~) API to query the data source list and obtain the **DataSourceId**.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.
></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 解析器ID。您可调用接口[ListParsers](~~429046~~)，查询解析器列表，获取**ParserId**。
description.en: The resolver ID. You can call the [ListParsers](~~429046~~) API to query the resolver list and obtain the **ParserId**.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
已调用接口创建数据源（[CreateParserDataSource](~~433011~~)）和解析器（[CreateParser](~~429044~~)）。

><notice>
1个解析器最多关联1个数据源，如果指定解析器已关联数据源，调用该接口会覆盖该解析器关联的原数据源。
></notice>

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You have already created a data source by calling the [CreateParserDataSource](~~433011~~) API and a resolver by calling the [CreateParser](~~429044~~) API.

><notice>
A resolver can be associated with at most one data source. If the specified resolver is already associated with a data source, calling this API will overwrite the original data source associated with the resolver.
></notice>

## Queries Per Second (QPS) Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 10.
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
